name: Chien Chung-Wei (簡忠威)
fit_reason: atmospheric urban and interior watercolor, quiet scenes, strong tonal control. Built international credibility from a Taiwan base through IWS competitions.
use_as: Primary career-path reference for building international watercolor credibility from an Asian base.

name: Tatsuro Kiuchi (木内達朗)
fit_reason: Atmospheric space for book jackets, editorial and advertising - Ikeido Jun's novels, the New York Times, Penguin, Uniqlo. Works without an agent; commissions come direct.
use_as: Reference for the commissioned/editorial route, and proof it runs without an agent.

name: Thomas W. Schaller
fit_reason: Architectural watercolor — buildings, urban light, atmosphere, quiet structural observation. Large-format architectural studies with dramatic mood.
use_as: Primary reference for architectural watercolor practice and aesthetic.

name: Cathy Read
fit_reason: British architectural watercolorist known for Edinburgh and UK urban scenes. Has exhibited in London and internationally.
use_as: Reference for building an architectural watercolor career with direct-to-collector sales.

name: Mateusz Urbanowicz
fit_reason: Tokyo architecture in watercolor - storefronts, streets, the city as an ongoing subject. Books with MdN (Tokyo Storefronts, Tokyo at Night); the series has passed 100,000 copies. Sells originals himself, no gallery.
use_as: Closest match for a city-as-subject watercolor practice that became books.

name: Keiko Tanabe
fit_reason: Japanese watercolor painter, urban and travel subjects, light and understated atmosphere. Has exhibited with AWS and NWS — Japan-rooted identity with international visibility.
use_as: Reference for Japan-origin watercolor career with international reach.

name: Lian Quan Zhen
fit_reason: Chinese-born watercolorist integrating Chinese ink painting sensibility with Western watercolor technique. AWS member.
use_as: Reference for cross-cultural watercolor identity — Chinese training meeting international exhibition contexts.

name: Alvaro Castagnet
fit_reason: Urban watercolor with loose, atmospheric style; strong international exhibition record built from a non-Western base. AWS signature member.
use_as: Reference for building international watercolor exhibition record through society competitions.

name: Jean Haines
fit_reason: Prominent UK watercolor practitioner and author. Style is loose and expressive — very different from GEGYjiji's quiet urban register. Community reference only.
use_as: Community reference only. Do NOT use as stylistic reference or aesthetic comparison.

name: Ohn Mar Win
fit_reason: Twenty-year practice across licensing and teaching. Publishes her own income breakdown: teaching 77%, licensing 3% - the clearest evidence available of what each route actually pays.
use_as: Evidence for what a course and a licensing practice really earn.
